ExistingEvidence.Finding: To demonstrate the unique properties of TPU-GF, we looked at a common pain point in the RC community: front-end collisions. We tested a fantastic Tamiya TT02 Flex Bumper model specifically engineered for high-speed kinetic impacts.
ExistingEvidence.Exposure / conditions: Maker-reported illustrated RC-bumper demonstration only; impact load/speed, geometry, specimen conditions and test protocol not published. No quantitative impact qualification or transfer to robotics.
ExistingEvidence.Locator: p. 1: Real-World Testing, Tamiya TT02 Flex Bumper; text line 247

ExistingEvidence.Finding: Printed in Siraya Tech TPU-GF, the bumper maintains its structural rigidity to protect the chassis during static loading, while flexing on heavy impacts to dissipate kinetic energy before snapping back into shape.
ExistingEvidence.Exposure / conditions: Maker-reported behaviour of this bumper; no measured load, impact speed, cycle life or protocol. No scale-up or industrial payload qualification.
ExistingEvidence.Locator: p. 1: 3D Model Showcase, TPU-GF bumper observation; text line 250

ExistingEvidence.Finding: Wet Sanding: Highly recommended to keep dust particles trapped in water rather than airborne.
ExistingEvidence.Exposure / conditions: Maker finishing guidance; grit, duration and achieved surface properties not stated.
ExistingEvidence.Locator: p. 1: 5. Post-Processing, Wet Sanding; text line 276
